# megooflags_sdk_key (Resource)

An SDK key of one environment. Destroying it revokes the key. The secret is only known when Terraform creates the key: after terraform import, secret is null.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "megooflags_sdk_key" "backend" {
  project     = megooflags_project.shop.key
  environment = "staging"
  name        = "backend"
  kind        = "server"
}

output "backend_sdk_key" {
  value     = megooflags_sdk_key.backend.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) Environment key. Changing it replaces the key.
- `kind` (String) server (server SDKs, sees the whole ruleset) or client (browser and mobile SDKs). Changing it replaces the key.
- `name` (String) Name. Changing it replaces the key.
- `project` (String) Project key. Changing it replaces the key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the key was created.
- `id` (String) Key ID.
- `prefix` (String) The start of the secret, shown in the UI to recognise the key.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The key for the SDK. Only known for keys Terraform created; null after import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <project>/<environment>/<key id>. An imported key has no
# secret: the API only returns it when the key is created.
terraform import megooflags_sdk_key.backend shop/staging/0b8f1c9e-2d4a-4c1e-9f57-3a6e8d2b7c10
```
